learn.title: Compliance and identity governance
objectives: Recommend Azure Policy effects, initiatives, exemptions and remediation to enforce and report compliance
Use Defender for Cloud regulatory compliance, the Microsoft cloud security benchmark and Microsoft Purview to assess and evidence compliance
Protect resources and audit evidence with resource locks, deployment stacks, immutable storage and long-term log retention, and meet data residency needs
Design identity governance with PIM, access reviews, entitlement management and lifecycle workflows
Govern Conditional Access, guest users, emergency access accounts and separation of duties
concepts: Policy initiative
A set of policy definitions assigned as one unit. Regulatory initiatives group definitions into controls with policy definition groups.
Policy effects
Deny blocks new non-compliant requests, Audit and AuditIfNotExists only report, Modify and DeployIfNotExists change resources, DenyAction blocks deletes, Manual records attestations.
Remediation task
Applies Modify or DeployIfNotExists to resources that existed before the assignment. Uses the assignment's managed identity, which needs the required roles.
Policy exemption
Removes a scope from enforcement while keeping it visible in compliance as Waiver or Mitigated, with an optional expiry date.
Microsoft cloud security benchmark
The default standard in Defender for Cloud regulatory compliance. Other standards such as PCI DSS or ISO 27001 can be added.
Microsoft Purview
Data Map scans and classifies data sources and captures lineage. Compliance Manager tracks regulatory assessments, improvement actions and a compliance score.
Resource locks
CanNotDelete or ReadOnly on control-plane operations, inherited by child scopes. Only roles with Microsoft.Authorization/locks permissions, such as Owner, can remove them.
Deployment stacks
Manage a set of resources as one unit and apply deny settings (DenyDelete or DenyWriteAndDelete). With template specs they replace the deprecated Azure Blueprints.
Privileged Identity Management
Eligible, time-bound role and group assignments with activation rules, approval, alerts, audit history and access reviews of privileged roles.
Access reviews
Recurring recertification of group, app, role and guest access, with single or multi-stage reviewers, default decisions and auto-apply.
Entitlement management
Catalogs of access packages that bundle groups, apps and SharePoint sites, with request policies, approvals, expiry, connected organizations and separation-of-duties checks.
Lifecycle workflows
Joiner, mover and leaver automation triggered by attributes such as employeeHireDate and employeeLeaveDateTime. Needs Microsoft Entra ID Governance.
comparisons: Deny vs DenyAction vs resource lock
Deny stops non-compliant creates and updates. DenyAction stops deletes for matching resources and is managed centrally. A lock stops changes on one scope but a local Owner can remove it.
Audit checks the resource itself. AuditIfNotExists reports a missing related resource. DeployIfNotExists also deploys that related resource.
An exclusion removes a scope from the assignment completely. An exemption keeps it in compliance reports with a reason category and expiry.
Defender for Cloud regulatory compliance vs Purview Compliance Manager

Defender for Cloud maps technical resource assessments in Azure, AWS and GCP to standards. Compliance Manager covers broader programmes, including Microsoft-managed and procedural controls and Microsoft 365.
Access reviews recertify access that already exists. Entitlement management governs how access is requested, approved, expired and removed, and can include reviews.
Dynamic groups change membership from attributes. Lifecycle workflows run tasks at a point in time, such as sending a Temporary Access Pass, disabling an account or removing access packages.
traps: Deny, Modify and DeployIfNotExists do not fix existing resources on their own. Existing resources need a remediation task (Modify or DeployIfNotExists), or manual fixes for Deny.
Resource locks do not protect data-plane operations: a CanNotDelete lock on a storage account does not stop blob deletion, and a ReadOnly lock on a VM does not stop RDP.
A ReadOnly lock can break things: on a storage account it blocks listing keys.
Emergency access accounts must be cloud-only, permanently assigned Global Administrator and excluded from Conditional Access, not synced, federated or PIM-eligible.
Access review decisions do nothing until they are applied. Turn on auto-apply and choose what happens when reviewers don't respond.
Only a group created as role-assignable can hold Microsoft Entra roles. You can't convert an existing group.
revision: Report only: Audit or AuditIfNotExists. Block: Deny. Fix: Modify or DeployIfNotExists plus remediation. Block deletes centrally: DenyAction.
Roll out a policy safely with enforcementMode DoNotEnforce. Use exemptions with expiry dates for approved exceptions.
Data residency: Allowed locations and Allowed locations for resource groups at a management group. Check paired regions before you choose GRS.
Keep the activity log (90 days) and Microsoft Entra logs (30 days) longer with diagnostic settings. Use immutable storage for WORM evidence.
Blueprints are deprecated. Use template specs for versioned templates and deployment stacks with deny settings for protection.
PIM governance: eligible assignments, authentication context on activation, alerts and recurring access reviews of privileged roles.
External users: entitlement management with connected organizations, expiry and automatic removal, plus access reviews of inactive guests.
Lifecycle workflows handle joiner, mover and leaver tasks, run on a schedule (every 3 hours by default) and can run on demand.

Group owners

questions.q: How should the Global Administrator role be assigned to emergency access accounts?
opts: As a time-bound active assignment
Through a role-assignable group with PIM approval
As an eligible PIM assignment
As a permanent active assignment
questions.e: Emergency accounts must work when PIM or approvers are unavailable, so the role is permanently active.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions

questions.q: A custom policy definition must be assigned to 25 subscriptions under the Corp management group and to any new subscription added there. Where should you save the definition?
opts: In each of the 25 subscriptions
In a template spec in the platform subscription
At the Corp management group
In a resource group in the first subscription
questions.e: A definition can be assigned only at or below the scope where it is saved.

questions.q: Auditors want a report of Key Vaults that have no diagnostic setting. The platform team doesn't want policies to deploy anything. Which effect should you use?
opts: Modify
Append
DeployIfNotExists
AuditIfNotExists

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: A Defender for Cloud recommendation flags VMs that lack an endpoint protection solution, but the company uses an approved third-party tool that Defender for Cloud doesn't detect. The finding must stop affecting the secure score. What should you recommend?
opts: Add a CanNotDelete lock on the VMs
Exempt the recommendation for those VMs with the Mitigated category
Delete the Microsoft cloud security benchmark assignment
Disable Defender for Cloud on the subscription

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: Auditors want the same OS baseline reports for 300 on-premises Windows servers as for Azure VMs, in the same Azure Policy view. What should you recommend?
opts: Onboard the servers to Azure Arc and assign Machine Configuration policies
Install the Log Analytics agent and run custom queries
Add the servers to Defender for Cloud secure score manually
Scan the servers with the Microsoft Purview Data Map

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: A central team must query policy compliance across 200 subscriptions and export non-compliant resources with one query. What should you recommend?
opts: Activity log searches per subscription
Azure Advisor recommendations per subscription
Azure Resource Graph queries on the policy resources table
Defender for Cloud secure score per subscription

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: An insurer must find columns that hold its internal policy numbers, which use a pattern of three letters followed by eight digits. Purview has no built-in classification for this. What should you recommend?
opts: A custom classification rule with a regular expression pattern in Microsoft Purview
A sensitivity label applied to each table by hand
A Defender for Cloud custom recommendation
A custom Azure Policy definition that audits storage accounts

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: A Deny policy that requires HTTPS-only storage accounts was assigned a week ago. Several older accounts still allow HTTP. What explains this?
opts: Deny policies take seven days to apply to existing resources
Existing accounts are exempt until they are restarted
Deny blocks non-compliant creates and updates only, so existing resources are reported but not changed
Deny policies don't evaluate storage accounts

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: A storage account has a CanNotDelete lock, yet an administrator deleted thousands of blobs with a script. The data must be recoverable in future. What should you recommend?
opts: Turn on blob soft delete and versioning, because locks don't protect data-plane operations
Move the lock to the resource group
Add a second CanNotDelete lock on the subscription
Replace the lock with a ReadOnly lock on the storage account

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: A company runs 30 AKS clusters. It must stop privileged containers and report pod security compliance centrally, with minimal effort. What should you recommend?
opts: Microsoft Purview Data Map scans of each cluster
Activity log alerts on cluster updates
The Azure Policy add-on for AKS with a built-in pod security initiative
Resource locks on each AKS cluster

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: For a data protection audit, a company must show how personal data moves from source systems through Azure Data Factory pipelines into a data warehouse. What should you recommend?
opts: Send Data Factory activity logs to a storage account
Connect Azure Data Factory to Microsoft Purview to capture lineage in the Data Map
Enable Defender for Cloud on the data factory
Assign Azure Policy initiatives to the data factory

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: The security team suspects some admins are being given Microsoft Entra roles directly instead of through PIM. They want to be told when this happens, with minimal effort. What should you recommend?
opts: A Conditional Access policy for directory roles
A CanNotDelete lock on the tenant root management group
Review the PIM alert for roles assigned outside Privileged Identity Management
A quarterly access review of all users in the tenant

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: An access review finished and reviewers denied 50 users, but those users still have access a week later. What is the most likely cause?
opts: Auto-apply results was turned off and nobody applied the results
Access reviews can only remove guest users
The review used managers as reviewers
Denied users keep access until the next review

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Managers review access to a SaaS app, but some users have no manager set in Microsoft Entra ID. Those users must still be reviewed. What should you configure?
opts: An access package with manager approval
Self-review for all users in the review
Fallback reviewers in the access review
A second access review for users with no manager

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Requests for a research data access package must be approved first by the requester's manager and then by the data owner. What should you configure?
opts: A multi-stage access review of the access package
A lifecycle workflow that adds the data owner
Two separate access packages for the same resources
A request policy in the access package with two approval stages

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Every quarter, sponsors must confirm that users assigned the Contractors access package still need it. What should you recommend to minimise effort?
opts: Turn on access reviews in the access package's assignment policy
Use a lifecycle workflow to email sponsors every quarter
Lower the package expiry to one day
Create a separate access review for each contractor

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: When an access package request is approved, a ticket must be created in the company's IT service management tool. What should you recommend?
opts: A Conditional Access policy with a custom control
An entitlement management custom extension that calls an Azure Logic Apps workflow
A lifecycle workflow triggered by group membership
An access review that emails the IT team

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Each department must create and manage its own access packages for its own resources, without being given tenant-wide governance roles. What should you recommend?
opts: The Groups Administrator role for each department lead
One shared catalog with all department leads as access package managers
The Identity Governance Administrator role for each department lead
A catalog for each department, with department leads as catalog owners

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Lifecycle workflows depend on reliable employeeHireDate and employeeLeaveDateTime values. The company uses Workday as its HR system. What should you recommend?
opts: Ask managers to update the attributes in the portal
Copy the attributes from sign-in logs each night
Inbound provisioning from Workday to set the attributes
Set the attributes from Conditional Access policies

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Employees may invite guests only from three named partner domains. What should you configure?
opts: A Conditional Access policy that targets the three domains
A dynamic group for each partner domain
An access review of guests from other domains
An allow list of the domains in the external collaboration settings

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Guests can currently browse the list of users and groups in the directory. They should see only their own directory objects. What should you change?
opts: The cross-tenant inbound settings to block all apps
The Conditional Access policy for guests to require MFA
The guest user access restriction setting to the most restrictive level
The guest invite setting to admins only

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Before using a partner portal app, guests must accept a data handling agreement, and acceptance must be recorded. What should you recommend?
opts: Microsoft Entra terms of use enforced through a Conditional Access policy
An access package policy with a justification field
An access review with self-review for guests
A Conditional Access policy that requires MFA

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: The governance board wants every Conditional Access change versioned, reviewed and able to be rolled back. What should you recommend?
opts: Back up the policies by taking screenshots after each change
Assign the policies through Azure Policy initiatives
Manage the policies as JSON in a repository and deploy them through Microsoft Graph from a pipeline
Store the policies as template specs in a subscription

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: You open the Conditional Access insights and reporting workbook, but it shows no data. What is the most likely cause?
opts: The tenant has no emergency access accounts
Sign-in logs aren't being sent to a Log Analytics workspace
PIM isn't turned on for the tenant
No Conditional Access policy is in the On state

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Azure portal sign-ins now require MFA for all accounts, including emergency access accounts. Which method should you recommend for those accounts?
opts: Voice calls to the help desk line
Microsoft Authenticator on one admin's personal phone
SMS codes sent to an administrator's phone
FIDO2 security keys stored securely and kept separate
questions.e: Microsoft recommends phishing-resistant methods such as passkeys (FIDO2) or certificate-based authentication for emergency access accounts.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: An operations team needs Contributor on six subscriptions and Reader on another four, only when on call. You want to manage this as one just-in-time activation. What should you recommend?
opts: Give each user permanent Contributor at the management group
Assign the roles to a group and make membership eligible with PIM for Groups
Make each user eligible for each role at each subscription
Create a custom role that combines Contributor and Reader

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Evaluate these statements about Microsoft Entra access reviews. 1: A review can have up to three stages. 2: Access reviews are available with Microsoft Entra ID Free. 3: When reviewers don't respond, the review can apply the system recommendations. Which statements are true?
opts: Statements 1 and 3 only
Statements 1 and 2 only
Statements 2 and 3 only
Statement 3 only

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: Evaluate these statements about resource locks. 1: A lock on a resource group applies to its resources. 2: A ReadOnly lock on a VM stops users signing in to the VM over RDP. 3: The Contributor role can remove a CanNotDelete lock. Which statements are true?
opts: Statements 1 and 3 only
Statements 1 and 2 only
Statements 1, 2 and 3
Statement 1 only
questions.e: Locks affect control-plane operations only. Removing them needs Microsoft.Authorization/locks permissions, which Contributor lacks.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: A Brazilian company must keep all storage data in Brazil. It uses Brazil South and needs protection from a datacentre failure. A colleague suggests geo-redundant storage. What should you recommend?
opts: Zone-redundant storage in Brazil South, because the paired region for GRS is outside Brazil
Locally redundant storage with a CanNotDelete lock
Geo-redundant storage, because GRS always stays in the same country
Read-access geo-redundant storage with the secondary set to Brazil Southeast
questions.e: Brazil South is paired with South Central US, so GRS would copy data out of Brazil.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: A company has an internal security standard with 30 numbered controls. Compliance must be reported per control, using both built-in and custom policy definitions, in the Azure Policy compliance view. What should you recommend?
opts: One policy assignment per control with the control number in its name
A custom initiative that uses policy definition groups for each control
A tag on each resource listing the controls it meets
A Compliance Manager assessment with a policy for each control

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: Production SQL servers across 30 subscriptions must not be deleted, even by subscription Owners. Updates must still work, and the control must be managed centrally with minimal effort. What should you recommend?
opts: A DenyAction policy for delete operations assigned at the management group
A CanNotDelete lock on each SQL server
A ReadOnly lock on each production subscription
A Deny policy for SQL server resources assigned at each subscription
questions.e: Subscription Owners can remove locks, but they can't change a policy assigned above their scope. DenyAction blocks deletes and allows updates.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: An engineering team must see which Azure, AWS and GCP resources fail ISO 27001 controls, with remediation steps for each resource. What should you recommend?
opts: Azure Policy guest configuration on each cloud's VMs
Defender for Cloud regulatory compliance with the AWS and GCP connectors
Purview Compliance Manager with an ISO 27001 assessment filled in manually
Azure Resource Graph queries across the three clouds

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: You try to assign the Helpdesk Administrator role to an existing security group, but the group doesn't appear in the list. What should you do?
opts: Add a dynamic membership rule to the group
Convert the group to a Microsoft 365 group
Turn on the role-assignable option on the existing group
Create a new group with the role-assignable option turned on and move the members
questions.e: The isAssignableToRole property can only be set when the group is created.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Evaluate these statements about lifecycle workflows. 1: A workflow can be run on demand for selected users. 2: The scheduled run interval can be changed from the default of every three hours. 3: Time-based triggers work only for users synced from on-premises Active Directory. Which statements are true?
opts: Statements 1 and 3 only
Statement 1 only
Statements 1 and 2 only
Statements 2 and 3 only

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: Microsoft Purview scans of Azure SQL Database work, but the scan of an on-premises SQL Server in a private network fails to connect. What should you recommend?
opts: Install a self-hosted integration runtime that can reach the server
Move the Purview account to the same region as the server
Onboard the server to Azure Arc and assign a policy
Use the Azure integration runtime with a public endpoint

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: A broker must keep activity logs in write-once-read-many storage for six years. Logs are written continuously by a diagnostic setting, and nobody, including admins, may delete them early. What should you recommend?
opts: An unlocked time-based immutability policy without append writes
Blob soft delete with a retention of six years
A CanNotDelete lock on the storage account
A locked time-based immutability policy with protected append writes on the destination container
questions.e: Diagnostic settings write to append blobs, so the immutability policy must allow protected append writes.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: You are designing guest user lifecycle management with minimal administrative effort. Which should you NOT recommend?
opts: Run recurring access reviews of inactive guest users
Bring partners in through access packages that expire
Rely on Microsoft Entra ID to delete guests who haven't redeemed their invitation after 30 days
Limit guest invitations to admins and the Guest Inviter role
questions.e: Microsoft Entra ID doesn't automatically delete unredeemed guest invitations.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Microsoft-managed Conditional Access policies appeared in your tenant in report-only mode. The governance board wants to approve each one before it is enforced. What should you recommend?
opts: Review the report-only results and turn off any policy that isn't approved before Microsoft enables it
Delete the Microsoft-managed policies from the tenant
Leave them in report-only mode, because Microsoft never enables them
Exclude all users from each policy until the board meets
questions.e: Microsoft-managed policies start in report-only and are turned on after at least 90 days unless an admin sets them to Off.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Contractors get access through several access packages. On their employeeLeaveDateTime, all their packages and pending requests must be removed and their account disabled, with no manual steps. What should you recommend?
opts: A quarterly access review of each access package
A leaver lifecycle workflow with tasks to remove access package assignments, cancel pending requests and disable the account
Access package policies that expire after one year
A Conditional Access policy that blocks users after their leave date

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for identity governance
questions.q: Auditors want every Owner role activation in PIM from the past 12 months, with its justification, and the data must be searchable. What should you recommend?
opts: Rely on the default audit log retention in Microsoft Entra ID
Export the PIM audit history from the portal once a year
Use the Azure activity log with its default retention
Send Microsoft Entra audit logs to a Log Analytics workspace with one year of retention
questions.e: Microsoft Entra audit logs are kept for only 30 days by default, so send them to a workspace with longer retention.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for managing compliance
questions.q: Some controls in a regulatory initiative, such as a documented incident response plan, can't be checked automatically. Their status must still appear in the same compliance view. What should you recommend?
opts: Tags on the subscription with the control status
Compliance Manager improvement actions linked to each resource
Policy definitions with the Manual effect and attestations for those controls
Policy definitions with the Audit effect on a dummy resource
